title: Docs guides
description: Check the docs guides and blog posts against the registry: compile their TypeScript and Angular template blocks, validate their ndop.json and registry.json blocks, and check the directives, items and component links they name (ADR-0030).

posts.description: Workspace-relative folder of blog posts, holding <slug>.md, checked as guides are.

registry.description: Workspace-relative folder of the built registry's JSON: index.json, <item>.json and metadata/.

tsconfig.description: Workspace-relative tsconfig whose paths resolve @/ to the registry and the @ndop packages.

workDir.description: Workspace-relative folder the blocks are written to and compiled in; emptied on every run.
